_comment: Product names speech-to-text mishears. Correct spelling -> misheard variants (case-insensitive, whole words; any whitespace or a hyphen between the words). Each variant is replaced in the transcript before the agents see it, and the list is shown to the modeller, consolidator and extractor as KNOWN TERMS. Only multi-word variants for real words: never map a bare name like 'jeff' or 'java'.
